name: Thoracic Radiculopathy
definition: Thoracic nerve-root dysfunction causing dermatomal band-like pain or sensory symptoms around the chest or abdomen, with multiple spinal and non-spinal mimics.

typical: Pain worsened by spinal movement or cough in some cases

investigations.principle: Imaging depends on persistent symptoms and red flags.
investigations.MRI: Thoracic MRI is preferred when structural root/cord disease is suspected.
investigations.radiographs: Radiographs may show fracture or gross bony disease only.

green: Activity modification and rehabilitation when mechanical
amber: Do not label thoracic pain as radiculopathy before excluding visceral emergencies when appropriate.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Parshva/Prishtha Vata-radiating phenotype may be documented descriptively.

patientEducation.summary: Thoracic nerve-root dysfunction causing dermatomal band-like pain or sensory symptoms around the chest or abdomen, with multiple spinal and non-spinal mimics.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute/progressive neurological deficit, severe infection/systemic illness, major trauma, vascular compromise or other listed red flags.
